confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Belgrade price levels, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and location and is likely the least certain. Cocktail and wine are bounded using the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page; I did not open that page or the F11.1 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Central and Southeast European capitals priced below Western and Central EU hubs, roughly in the range of Sofia, Budapest, and Zagreb with a lower restaurant and hostel tier.
